# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in results from simulations:

```{r load-results}
D1_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D1/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D2_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D3_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D3/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
D4_power_summary <- readRDS("Outputs/D4/Extinct/power_summary.rds")
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare D1 with D2, D3, and D4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3

D2_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D2_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D2")
)

D3_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D3_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D3")
)

D4_joined <- left_join(
  D1_power_summary,
  D4_power_summary,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D4")
)

D1_plot <- ggplot(D1_power_summary) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early, y = later)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D1 (Matched)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D2_plot <- ggplot(D2_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D2, yend = later_D2), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D2, y = later_D2)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D2 (Constant)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D3_plot <- ggplot(D3_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D3, yend = later_D3), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D3, y = later_D3)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D3 (Inverted)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

D4_plot <- ggplot(D4_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1, xend = early_D4, yend = later_D4), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D1, y = later_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = early_D4, y = later_D4)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Power Early After Extinction",
    y = "Average Power Later After Extinction",
    title = "D4 (Increasing)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))

ggarrange(D1_plot, D2_plot, D3_plot, D4_plot, ncol = 4)
```

# Illustrative Figure

Plot sighting rates:

```{r sighting-rate-plot}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 2
extinction_time <- 100
max_test_time <- 200

eps <- 0.5
p_i <- 0.7
p_r <- 0.5

pse <- eps * p_i * p_r

D1_rates <- tibble(
  scenario = "D1 (Matched)",
  time = seq(0, max_test_time, by = 1),
  c_rate = c(
    rep(pse, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(0, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  ),
  u_rate = c(
    rep(pse, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(0, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  )
)

D2_rates <- tibble(
  scenario = "D2 (Constant)",
  time = seq(0, max_test_time, by = 1),
  c_rate = c(
    rep(pse, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(0, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  ),
  u_rate = rep(pse, max_test_time + 1)
)

D3_rates <- tibble(
  scenario = "D3 (Inverted)",
  time = seq(0, max_test_time, by = 1),
  c_rate = c(
    rep(pse, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(0, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  ),
  u_rate = c(
    rep(0, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(pse, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  )
)

D4_rates <- tibble(
  scenario = "D4 (Increasing)",
  time = seq(0, max_test_time, by = 1),
  c_rate = c(
    rep(pse, extinction_time + 1),
    rep(0, max_test_time - extinction_time)
  ),
  u_rate = pse * (0:max_test_time) / extinction_time
)

sighting_rates <- bind_rows(D1_rates, D2_rates, D3_rates, D4_rates)

ggplot(sighting_rates) +
  geom_step(aes(x = time, y = u_rate), colour = "darkred") +
  geom_step(aes(x = time, y = c_rate), colour = "darkblue", linetype = "11") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = extinction_time, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, ncol = 4, nrow = 1, axes = "all") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.0, "lines")
  ) +
  lims(x = c(0, max_test_time), y = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Sighting Rate")
```
